tasks.short: Detect abnormal equipment sounds and well conditions

steps.what: Listen to engines, rotary chains and other equipment during operation
Distinguish faulty operations or unusual well conditions from normal running sounds

tasks.design: Keep listening and interpreting with the operator at {OTHER}. An equipment alarm can supplement awareness, but installing it does not establish a reduction in this listening task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sounds depend on load, equipment and well conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated labour-saving change for this task boundary.
tasks.still_hard: An unfamiliar sound may precede a dangerous fault.

ambition.what: Improve recognition of abnormal conditions without reducing attention.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: equipment sounds require interpretation in operating context.

assumptions: Boundary is detecting conditions by listening; repair, stopping equipment and later service reporting are separate tasks. No record-writing deliverable is folded into listening.
OTHER means the physical service unit. No sensor runtime is counted as human labour.
Shares are provisional task decomposition, not measured times or prompt means priors. B=100, R=100, gross=0; incremental=0; net=0.
unknowns: Whether existing acoustic monitoring changes the required listening duty
research_questions: Observe when the operator must listen despite existing alarms.

incremental.description: No new process or system upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No claimed reduction in the physical listening or interpretation under either current or alarm-assisted operation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare accurate service reports for billing

steps.what: Capture actual services, tools used and start and finish times
Match the service job and actual usage to applicable billing references
Assemble the services, tools and time into the billing report draft
Check and approve the final report against the work actually performed
outputs: approved billing report v1 and named recipient

steps.what: Save the approved billing report in its current record
inputs: approved billing report v1 and named recipient

steps.what: Send the approved billing report to the billing office
inputs: approved billing report v1 and named recipient
outputs: billing report v1 sent to billing office

tasks.design: Configure {OPS_SYSTEM} to assemble a billing report from the operator's actual service rows and matched {ERP} references. The operator resolves exceptions and approves the completed report and recipient, then a separate gated {EMAIL} action sends that exact version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual usage and billing references can be held in separate records.
tasks.enabler_now: Structured actuals and deterministic report mapping can remove report assembly and attachment handling.
tasks.still_hard: Unrecorded work and disputed usage cannot be inferred from the planned job.
tasks.human_edge: Confirm what happened and explain exceptions.

ambition.what: Produce a traceable billing report from actual service data.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: deterministic templates can assemble structured service, tool and duration records into reports.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual capture, report preparation, approval, save and delivery to billing; it excludes creating or posting an invoice.

The operator supplies job ID, service code, actual tool ID and quantity, start/end time, interruptions and factual work description in s1. Approved master codes already have a billing owner; unchanged maintenance is outside this task. Missing fields require operator entry, never planned-value substitution.
Test native service-report configuration first. The saving hypothesis requires actual manual matching, report composition and sending today; existing native coverage removes the corresponding saving.
Same-record save is effectively zero today; schema minimum share 1 is retained at 100% and earns no saving. Draft regeneration or edits invalidate both approvals until final review.
Provisional shares are independent of means priors. B=100, R=62, gross=38; incremental focal upkeep=1 per 100 baseline hours; net=37.
unknowns: Actual report preparation time and missing-data rate
research_questions: Trace completed jobs from actual capture through billing receipt and measure manual report work.

already_counted.description: Check report quantities, times, meaning and final recipient

incremental.description: Maintain report-field mappings and test delivery failures

approvals.approved_version: approved billing report v1 and named recipient
approved billing report v1 and named recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: native reporting already covers this work so no change is deployed. High: manual assembly and sends exist, but an extra 7 hours per 100 are needed for incomplete actuals beyond the central 37 net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Gather pipe, tool and borehole information from colleagues

steps.what: Identify the well reference and existing pipe or tool information for the discussion
Confer with crew and specialists about pipe sizes, tool sizes and borehole conditions
Record the confirmed dimensions and uncertainty in the well job note

tasks.design: Use the existing {OPS_SYSTEM} well note to capture confirmed dimensions, source and uncertainty. Retain the conversation: access to records does not replace asking about conditions that the crew has just observed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The newest condition may be known only to the crew.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing record fields support capture, but no additional saving is established.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve conflicting recollections and incomplete downhole information.
tasks.human_edge: Ask follow-up questions and judge reliability.

ambition.what: Preserve the source and uncertainty of operational information.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: structured well notes can retain reported dimensions and their sources, while conversations clarify uncertain conditions.

assumptions: Boundary includes reference lookup, conferencing and recording the information gathered. Physical measurement is separate, not replaced by a record.

s3 capture fields are well ID, pipe/tool ID, reported dimension and units, reporting person, observation time and uncertainty; the operator enters them from s2. Unknowns remain unknown. Native fields are evaluated first; no repeated hunting or double entry is assumed.
Shares are provisional and independent of the prompt prior. B=100, R=100, gross=0, incremental=0, net=0.
unknowns: Whether recordings are permitted or useful
research_questions: Observe a conference and its resulting note before proposing transcription.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Lookup and note writing are explicit. Existing structured capture alone does not establish a shorter conversation or less writing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select fishing methods and tools for well obstructions

steps.what: Read the obstruction description, borehole conditions and available tool specifications
outputs: selection constraints with units and unknowns

steps.what: Compare tool dimensions and rated limits with the recorded obstruction and well constraints
inputs: selection constraints with units and unknowns
outputs: checked compatibility table and unresolved cases

steps.what: Select the fishing method and tools after weighing recovery risks and uncertain conditions
inputs: checked compatibility table and unresolved cases
selection constraints with units and unknowns

tasks.design: Configure a dimension and rating comparison in {OPS_SYSTEM}, using explicit well constraints and tool specifications. It exposes incompatible and unknown cases; the operator selects the fishing method and tools after assessing downhole risk.
tasks.previous_blocker: Compatibility checks can require manual comparison of specifications.
tasks.enabler_now: Deterministic unit conversion and limit checks can assist the supported specification subset.
tasks.still_hard: A dimensionally compatible tool may be unsuitable for the actual obstruction.
tasks.human_edge: Select the recovery strategy under uncertainty.

ambition.what: Make specification comparisons traceable without delegating recovery judgement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: deterministic checks can compare dimensions, units and equipment ratings but do not determine downhole recovery suitability.

assumptions: Boundary is selecting the method and tools, not acquiring tools or carrying out fishing.

The existing well report is produced by prior well observation; it must contain well ID, obstruction type, depth, known dimensions, clearances, pressure/temperature constraints and uncertainty. s1 reads these and flags missing values. No planned values stand in for observations.

Catalogue owner already maintains tool ID, dimensions, units, ratings and applicability restrictions; unchanged work is outside this task. Missing or ambiguous specifications require manual comparison in s2. Focal mapping upkeep is separately priced.

Native compatibility features are checked first. The central hypothesis covers 50% of comparison effort with usable structured fields; the rest stays manual. No saving is claimed for reading or selecting.
Provisional B=100, R=85, gross=15; focal incremental upkeep=1; net=14. Shares derive from this task, not the means prior.
research_questions: Test past selections for missing dimensions and false compatibility results.

already_counted.description: Check unsupported specifications and comparison exceptions

incremental.description: Check tool-schema mappings and changed comparison rules

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: native checks already suffice, so no change. High: supported comparisons save 15 hours but four additional hours of missing-field checks beyond central and one hour of upkeep leave 10.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep well operations and recovery judgement with the operator; improve billing preparation and specification comparison.
reach: Billing office: understand how actual usage becomes report lines
skills_to_grow: Capture actual usage with units and sources
Distinguish compatibility checks from recovery decisions
role.ambitious_version: A service operator whose actual work records feed billing and whose tool choices are supported by traceable specification checks.
